content: screencapture from Terminal requires the RESPONSIBLE PROCESS (per Tahoe's TCC model, the process actually invoking the capture, not necessarily the parent Terminal app) to hold the Screen Recording grant; permissions cannot be newly GRANTED from the command line (only reset, via tccutil reset ScreenCapture) -- granting is UI/MDM-only. macOS 15+ also re-prompts monthly for standing Screen Recording grants, so a daemon-invoked screencapture can silently regress a working grant to unauthorized without any code change.
